title: Native rows: rounded selection that follows the window, tinted chips and system dates
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; press j twice in the Inbox and look at the rows and dates
Click the search field, then click another app's window, then come back
In Settings > Appearance, try each density, then open the Important split
expected: One-line rows, 40 pt by default (32/48). Unread senders are semibold, read ones medium; snippets grey. Dates read 10:42 AM, Yesterday or Oct 12 in steady grey digits, never in capitals. The selected row is a rounded accent tint while the window is key, even with search focused, and light grey behind another window. Chips are tinted capsules; the Important split shows no Important chip.
